the presented network-based method can be used for the visualization and analysis of collaboratively edited texts, and that the visualization can be used to analyze the contributions of the contributors regarding the nature of the concept relations they introduce.

the network analysis of collaboratively edited documents can be used to identify the nature of contributions of individual users and to characterize the development of the text in terms of the nature of the relations between the concepts.
the proposed approach can be used to analyze the contributions of authors of collaboratively edited texts in terms of the nature of relations they introduce to a text.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis and visualization of dynamic concept networks that are derived from evolving texts.
the development of an approach for the visualization of concept networks extracted from collaboratively edited text and their analysis.
a new approach to visualize and analyze collaboratively edited texts in order to gain insights into the collaborative writing process.

the proposed approach provides a useful and intuitive way to visualize the content of a text and its evolution in a compact and easy to understand way, which is particularly useful to support collaborative writing processes.
the proposed approach can be used to identify and visualize the contributions of different authors to a text, and that the approach is suitable to be used in a collaborative writing scenario.
the proposed method is a useful tool for the visualization and analysis of collaboratively edited texts.

the presented approach provides a novel way to visualize and analyze the structure and dynamics of evolving texts.
the presented network based approach is able to visualize the evolution of texts and their underlying concept networks.
the proposed approach provides a new way of analyzing collaboratively edited texts and their authors by means of a network-based approach.

network visualization can be used to identify patterns in the collaborative writing process and to characterize the contributors.
network based analysis and visualization is a promising approach for the characterization of contributors in collaborative writing processes.
